name: Heavy Metal
def: Blues rock darkened, downtuned and amplified into ritual heaviness — tritone riffs, doom-laden lyrics and the guitar riff as monolith.

traits.v: Minor keys, tritones and power chords.
Heavy, deliberate backbeat built around the riff.

why: It slows and darkens electrified blues until the distorted riff itself becomes the composition's core.

tracks.why: Its tritone riff over a tolling bell is the founding gesture of metal.

name: Thrash Metal
def: Metal accelerated by hardcore punk — palm-muted riffing at breakneck tempo, precision aggression and an underground tape-trading ethos.

traits.v: Fast, palm-muted downpicking and double-kick drive.
Underground tape-trading and DIY metal clubs.

why: It fuses punk's velocity with metal's riff discipline into fast, precise aggression.

tracks.why: Eight minutes of riff architecture that made thrash the new metal standard.

name: Glam / Hair Metal
def: Metal teased, lacquered and aimed at MTV — pop hooks and power ballads under hard rock riffs, delivered with Sunset Strip spectacle.

traits.v: Huge pop choruses and stacked gang vocals.
Bright high-gain riffs and shredding solos.
Sunset Strip clubs and the MTV video age.

why: It points metal's riff and shred at the pop chart — image, hooks and the power ballad as commercial art.

tracks.why: Mutt Lange's stacked-chorus production is the hair-metal hit machine distilled.

name: Doom Metal
def: Sabbath's slowest instincts made a genre — glacial tempos, mournful melody and riffs stretched until heaviness becomes atmosphere.
why: It slows metal to a crawl so weight and dread, not speed, carry the music.

name: Desert Rock
def: The Palm Desert sound — Sabbath riffs detuned and jammed at generator parties in the California desert: fuzzy, groove-heavy and sun-baked psychedelic.

traits.v: Thick, downtuned fuzz, guitars through bass amps.
Generator parties in the Coachella Valley.

why: It loosens metal's riff into a hypnotic, psychedelic groove — heaviness played for trance rather than aggression.

tracks.why: Downtuned fuzz rolling in an endless groove — the desert sound defined.

name: Sludge Metal
def: Doom's crawl poisoned by hardcore's rage — tarry, feedback-caked riffs, screamed bile and a swampy Southern heaviness.

traits.v: Dirge crawls that lurch into hardcore bursts.
New Orleans and the post-Melvins underground.

why: It welds doom's glacial weight to hardcore's fury — heaviness as abjection rather than ritual.

tracks.why: One riff dragged to breaking point — the founding document of sludge.

name: Stoner Rock / Metal
def: The desert sound gone worldwide — huge, fuzzy, Sabbath-derived riffs slowed to a heavy-lidded groove, from Sleep's monolithic drones to Monster Magnet's space rock.

traits.v: Cranked fuzz and cavernous, vintage-amp warmth.
Man’s Ruin, Rise Above and the 90s riff underground.

why: It universalises desert rock's recipe — the giant fuzzed riff, repeated until hypnotic, as an end in itself.

tracks.why: A riff the size of a planet at a stoned crawl — the stoner metal blueprint.

name: Death Metal
def: Thrash pushed past its limits — guttural vocals, blast beats, downtuned tremolo riffing and virtuosic, labyrinthine song structures.
why: It extends thrash's speed and precision into deliberate extremity — growled vocals, blast beats and riff labyrinths.

tracks.why: Schuldiner's riffcraft defined death metal's balance of brutality and composition.

tempoNote: Blast sections push higher; doom-death passages far lower.

name: Black Metal
def: The Norwegian second wave — shrieked vocals, lo-fi production and icy tremolo riffing aimed at atmosphere, misanthropy and the sublime.

traits.v: Treble-heavy, lo-fi wall of tremolo guitar.

why: Lo-fi tremolo walls and shrieked vocals trade death metal's precision for freezing atmosphere.

tracks.why: Its raw tremolo chill is the blueprint of second-wave black metal.

tempoNote: Wide range — blast-beat fury beside slow atmospheric passages.

name: Post-Metal
def: Metal's weight applied to post-rock's patience — long, tidal builds where crushing riffs arrive as crescendo rather than constant assault.

traits.v: Layered, textural guitar beneath tectonic riffs.

why: It borrows post-rock's crescendo form and lets metal's heaviness land as a wave instead of a wall.

name: Blackgaze
def: Black metal's shriek and blast beats flooded with shoegaze's blissed-out wall of sound — extremity and euphoria in the same wash.

traits.v: Tremolo walls blurred into major-key shimmer.

why: It runs black metal's tremolo wall through shoegaze's dream-soaked layering, turning fury into bliss.

tracks.why: Black-metal shriek over pink-hued shoegaze bliss — the genre in one track.

name: Progressive Metal
def: Prog rock's odd meters and suite forms fused with metal's weight — virtuosic, conceptual and rhythmically labyrinthine.

traits.v: Odd meters, polyrhythm and syncopated riff cycles.

why: It sets prog's compositional ambition inside metal's riff discipline — complexity delivered at full weight.

tracks.why: Its polyrhythmic riff grid spawned the entire djent movement.

tempoNote: Highly variable — odd meters and multi-section suites defy a single tempo.

name: Metalcore
def: Hardcore punk's breakdowns welded to melodic metal riffing — scream-and-sing dynamics built around the mosh-part drop.

traits.v: Riff → breakdown architecture; scream verses, sung hooks.
Half-time breakdowns as the climactic payoff.

why: It grafts hardcore's breakdown culture onto melodic metal riffing, making the drop the destination.
tempoNote: Half-time breakdowns make the felt tempo swing widely within one song.

name: Modern Metalcore
def: The 2020s metal resurgence — metalcore re-armed with pop-grade production, deathcore extremity and genre-fluid features, filling arenas again.

traits.v: Extreme lows and soaring cleans in one song.

why: It fuses metalcore's breakdown architecture with modern production and extremity, pulling metal back into the mainstream.

tracks.why: A pop-crossover breakdown that put extreme metal back on award-show stages.

tempoNote: Variable — genre-fluid songs shift tempo and feel section to section.
